recommended_exp02.idea: Moderate attack-family loss-weight increase (attack_loss_weight 1.0 -> 1.5) on the baseline LINEAR Head 2 (revert EXP01 MLP). One factor vs baseline; config-only.
recommended_exp02.reason: EXP01 disproved Head-2 capacity as the lever. The remaining training lever is loss balance: more attack_loss_weight shifts the SHARED encoder toward attack-family discrimination (where the DoS-SlowHTTPTest<->FTP-BruteForce separation must come from) and counters the binary-conservative drift EXP01 showed. A head-only change cannot reach this.
target_metrics: test attack-family macro-F1 (primary), judged on reliable classes
rare-class macro-F1 as a GUARDRAIL (noisy, not the target)
binary macro-F1, end-to-end attribution, missed-attack rate as guardrails
recommended_exp02.expected_benefit: Small and uncertain: ~+0.00 to +0.02 attack-family macro-F1 if pressure helps the SlowHTTPTest/FTP pair; real win = SlowHTTPTest recall rising.
recommended_exp02.risk: A9.6 precedent (attack_loss_weight 1.5 hurt UNSW Head 2 + rare precision); blunt global lever; the pair may be feature-limited (no loss trick fixes it); rare-class precision dip. Hence a controlled test with explicit rejection criteria.

metric_to_optimize_answer: test attack-family macro-F1, decided on the RELIABLE large-support classes (esp. DoS-SlowHTTPTest recall / FTP precision). Rare-class macro-F1 is a guardrail not a target (12-96 sample noise). Routed attribution + missed-attack are Head-1 guardrails. Keep 0.5/0.5 validation selection (both runs already pick max-val-attack epoch). Never tune on test.
why_not_repeat_exp01: EXP01 (MLP capacity) left the DoS-SlowHTTPTest<->FTP-BruteForce pair unchanged (recall 0.437->0.431, FTP precision 0.688->0.686).
The 10 large classes are already at F1>=0.985 (no headroom); the macro is gated by the hard pair + noisy rare classes.
Repeating a disproved hypothesis wastes a controlled-experiment slot.
why_not_bigger_head2_now: A bigger head only re-draws boundaries inside the existing shared embedding; if SlowHTTPTest/FTP are entangled there, no head size separates them.
EXP01 already showed MLP head adds variance (noisy rare-class reshuffle) without moving the reliable hard pair.
Capacity is rejected by direct evidence; the next lever must change the shared-encoder objective (loss), not the head.

must_not_overwrite: any models/experiments or results/experiments EXP01 path

promotion_criteria.safety: no baseline/EXP01 overwrite; validation-only selection; train-only weights; single final test

rejection_criteria: Attack-family macro-F1 not beyond the noise band, or DoS-SlowHTTPTest unchanged (pair not separated).
Rare-class precision collapse (A9.6 pattern) or any rare class -> ~0.
Binary macro-F1 < 0.965, missed-attack rate materially worse, or end-to-end attribution worse.
Any factor changed beyond attack_loss_weight; any test tuning; NaN/unstable; baseline/EXP01 overwritten.
roadmap_exp03_to_exp10: EXP03 head2_focal_loss (gamma ~1.5-2.0, linear head): recommend_after_exp02; code change; targets hard SlowHTTPTest/FTP examples; gate on rare precision floors.
EXP04 targeted train-only class-weight emphasis on confused pair/weak_hard_classes: needs_main_control_decision (per-class hacking/model-zoo risk).
EXP05 two-stage fine-tuning (warmup -> partial encoder fine-tune): possible_later; code change; frozen encoder can't separate an entangled pair.
EXP06 validation-only Head-1 threshold calibration: possible_later; helps routing/recall not Head-2 macro; never tune on test.
EXP07 feature engineering to separate SlowHTTPTest/FTP: needs_main_control_decision; NEW preprocessing protocol, breaks comparability; only if EXP02/03 prove feature-limited.
EXP08 attack-only balanced sampler: possible_later; hard pair is not rare so limited upside; rare oversampling risks overfit/optimism.
EXP09 class-balanced (effective-number) loss: possible_later; unlikely to break the pair.
EXP10 accept baseline and stop: recommend if EXP02/03 do not beat baseline beyond noise (0.849 macro / 0.972 binary is already strong and largely ceiling-bound).

candidate_rankings.experiment: targeted class-weight tuning on confused pair

safe_reusable_ideas: Validation-only threshold calibration (EXP06; never on test).
unsafe_or_defer: Multi-checkpoint model-zoo / many competing finals (reject; keep one accepted final + isolated experiment checkpoints).
Separate specialist classifiers wired ad hoc (needs_main_control; model-zoo risk).
v1_v6_reference_notes.method: Conceptual reuse from prior V1/V6 idea-extraction docs; V1 not re-read or modified in this task.

multi_seed_requirement: All CICIDS experiments must use >=3 seeds and decide on 3-seed means; single-seed deltas (EXP01 included) are within noise.
